style: Premium minimal SaaS sonic-logo sting, light. The frame starts as solid Physiofit BlueDark; a circular aperture closes and locks as the head of the P, the rest of the mark grows out of it, the wordmark wipes in, hold, fade to paper.
font: none — the wordmark is the official vector logotype

asset_needs.status: official Physiofit Wort-Bild-Marke supplied by the user; paths used 1:1

reused.grain-overlay: fractal-noise grain, multiply, very low opacity, finite iteration count

hand_authored: full-frame aperture closing onto the P's head (power4.inOut)
stem grows out of the head via a widening clip circle; hairline ring echo
foot steps in, wordmark wipes from the mark, 102.5% -> 100% settle
minimal synthesized sound design composed to the beats

sound.character: calm, premium: round sine-based tones, slow blooms (20–150 ms attacks), no hard transients, no saturation, dark long room

cues.what: close — a soft, dark breath following the iris + a gentle swell grown from the bloom chord's own reverb, flowing through the lock
lock — a round felt-mallet D4 (octave whisper) and a slow-blooming Dmaj9 pad with a barely-felt D2 underneath
air — two soft glass tones A5 · E6, very quiet
foot — one soft high note F#5
word — a whisper of air with the wipe
everything settles into silence with the picture

brief: The intro opens on a solid field of Physiofit BlueDark. A circular aperture closes — fast in the middle, soft at both ends — revealing clean paper, and locks exactly as the round head of the P as a round, soft mallet note and a slow-blooming warm chord rise out of a gentle swell. The stem grows out of the head, the foot steps in, PHYSIOFIT wipes in from the mark, the frame settles a touch, holds, and fades to paper at 2.5s.
